description: Move a maintenance ticket through its lifecycle: OPEN to IN_PROGRESS when work starts, DONE when fixed, CANCELLED when it turns out to be a non-issue.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.
